No code, workflow, signing, attestation, key custody, cache or coordinator-protocol behavior changes in the supplied evidence, and no reachable runtime attack surface is introduced. The related threat IDs (T-034, T-054 and A-017 official-build identity, and T-041 cache) are unaffected by the text edits. Remaining integration question: the actual toolchain pin change (Xcode 27.2 selection in the workflow, build action or scripts, and the recorded final SDK check) is not in this batch, so it is unverified. The documentation is consistent with its stated 'final recorded SDK must match' check, but the reviewer cannot confirm that the workflows enforce it. The unchanged 'metallib_hash' expectation in the release doc is v0.10.8-specific, and a compiler bump could alter it. That is an operational concern the doc already tells operators to explain, not a security regression. Further review should look at any non-doc files in the full PR that implement the SDK/toolchain bump, including checksum or pinning of the Xcode install.
